name: Pink Horror

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: The Pink Horror splits into two Blue Horrors.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Blue Horror
options.text: p.349. Pink Horrors split into two Blue Horrors on death. Blue Horrors use the same statistics as Pink Horrors, with the following adjustments: SKILLS: Default 7, Awareness 7 (Passive 4), Psychic Mastery 8, Weapon Skill 8. WOUNDS: 3

abilities.name: Split
abilities.text: The Blue Horror splits into two Brimstone Horrors.

options.name: Brimstone Horror
options.text: p.349. Blue Horrors split into two Brimstone Horrors on death. Brimstone Horrors use the same statistics as Pink Horrors, with the following adjustments: SKILLS: Default 6, Awareness 5 (Passive 3), Psychic Mastery 7, Weapon Skill 7. WOUNDS: 1

mobAbilities.name: Magic Made Manifest
mobAbilities.text: As an action, the Mob of Horrors may collectively activate the Smite psychic power. Make a single Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test for the Mob. This power is always activated at the Transcendent Power Level.
